description: Search and filter the atlas. All filters optional and combinable. Returns compact records; use get_beach for a full profile.

country.description: ISO-2 code or country name (e.g. "PT" or "Portugal")

min_sea_temp_c.description: Minimum mean sea temperature in that month, or of the warmest month when no month is given

month.description: Rank and report the sea temperature for this month (name or 1-12)

query.description: Free-text match on beach name, region or country

shore_type.description: Shore type, from the beach own Wikidata classes. "beach" means Wikidata does not say.

name: search_beaches
title: Search beaches worldwide
